title: Select Manchuria soybean (Manchuria soybean): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Select Manchuria soybean: Yield and Maturity
metaDescription: Select Manchuria soybean is a grain soybean variety for Mindanao. About 70 days to harvest, 2 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: Select Manchuria soybean is a grain soybean variety, also sold or known as Manchuria soybean or NSIC Sy 16. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2020 as NSIC 2020 Sy 16. IPB, UPLB CA, College, Laguna bred it. It takes about 70 days from sowing to harvest, with 2 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.caption: From the NSIC registry and its seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Select Manchuria soybean takes about 70 days from sowing to harvest. That is 14.9 days faster than the average of the 19 grain soybean varieties with a day count, 84.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 2 t/ha matches the average of its group, 1.92. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 70 days dry season, 89 days wet season.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took a middling share of damage

blocks.text: The pests and diseases that hit soybean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 13.3 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed coat is yellow. The seed holds 40.7 percent crude protein.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** 1.96 t/ha dry season, 2.34 t/ha wet season.
**Fruit:** Yellow seed, about 13 to 14 g per 100 seeds, crude protein about 40.7 percent.
**Where:** Wet season (March to May planting) in eastern and central Mindanao.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: topped IPB's 2019 on farm soybean trials in Sumilao, Bukidnon. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Select Manchuria soybean

The registry recommends it for Mindanao in the wet season. Grain soybean goes to feed and food processors, while vegetable soybean, or edamame, is picked green. Pick a variety rated against rust, the main soybean disease here.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Manchuria soybean the same as Select Manchuria?
items.a: Yes. Manchuria soybean is another name for Select Manchuria, registered as NSIC 2020 Sy 16. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 70 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 2 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
The registry recommends it for Mindanao in the wet season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Select Manchuria?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
